title: Color references
slide_intent: Give producers a way to specify the same named color across media. Exact reference values make a production handoff repeatable.
strategic_value: The movement can reproduce recognizable hues across vendors and processes by keeping print and screen references attached to one name.
demonstration: Two ruled tables pair named color samples with Pantone, CMYK, RGB and hexadecimal values. The primary rows precede the light, mid and dark variants of the secondary families.
practical_value: Find the color by role and name, then read the value in the column for the intended output. Check ambiguous entries against an approved master before production.

content_islands.name: Reference instruction
content_islands.spec: Place a brief direction above the tables specifying use of the supplied values.

content_islands.name: Primary rows
content_islands.spec: Align the primary names and samples beneath labeled color-system columns.

content_islands.name: Secondary tables
content_islands.spec: Group rows by hue and tone across the two columns. Keep each chip on the same baseline as its numeric specifications.
